actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.SipDeviceServices.find#SipDevices').requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} ec.message.clearErrors() registrarEnabled = !!out.registrarEnabled const when = (millis) => millis ? ec.l10n.format(new Date(Number(millis)), 'MMM d, h:mm a') : '' deviceList = Array.from(out.deviceList || []).map((d) => ({sipDeviceId: d.sipDeviceId, name: d.name, username: d.username, profileText: d.deviceProfile === 'legacy' ? ec.l10n.localize('Legacy (MD5)') : ec.l10n.localize('Standard'), registeredText: Array.from(d.registrationList || []).map((r) => (r.userAgent || r.transport) + ' · ' + r.sourceAddress + ':' + r.sourcePort + ' · ' + ec.l10n.localize('until') + ' ' + when(r.expiresDate)).join('; ') || ec.l10n.localize('Not registered'), lastSeenText: when(d.lastSeenDate)})) profileOptions = [{key: 'standard', text: ec.l10n.localize('Standard (SHA-256)')}, {key: 'legacy', text: ec.l10n.localize('Legacy (MD5), for a phone without SHA-256')}]

label.text: Desk and soft phones that register with this server and ring with your calls.
The registrar is off on this server: phones cannot register until an administrator turns it on (sip_registrar_enabled).

link.confirmation: Make a new password? The phone stops working until you enter it.
Remove this phone? It stops ringing and cannot register again.
